title: Shards: Echo
description: A starship pilot waiting to jump hears on the radio that war has broken out on Earth. He jumps ten light-years, then seventy, with no fuel to return, and spends the rest of his life listening to humanity's old broadcasts arrive.

cover.alt: Earth as a single faint point of light inside a band of scattered sunlight, seen by Voyager 1 from six billion kilometres away
cover.credit: Pale Blue Dot Revisited, NASA / JPL, 2020. Public domain.

elements.title: The silent window
elements.text: Denis lies in the acceleration couch an hour past his jump window. Mission Control does not answer, and all he thinks about is the penalty for being late.

metadata.source_quote: He was late, and being late meant penalties.

image.alt: A rocket waiting on its launch pad at dawn, under a violet sky
image.credit: Early morning view of Pad B, KSC with ASTP Apollo/Saturn space vehicle on pad, NASA / JSC, 1975. Public domain.

elements.title: War on the scanner
elements.text: Breaking regulations, he switches on the radio scanner and hears, among thousands of stations, that war has begun between the Northern Alliance and the Islamists.

metadata.source_quote: War. West and East. The Northern Alliance and the Islamists.

image.alt: A giant dish antenna of NASA's Deep Space Network under a blue sky
image.credit: Tracks of a Giant, NASA / JPL, 2010. Public domain.

elements.title: Three objects in a wedge
elements.text: An angry voice in a language he does not know threatens him, and three objects close in on the radar. He slams the launch button.

metadata.source_quote: There was no time even to panic.

image.alt: A rocket waiting on its launch pad at dawn, under a violet sky
image.credit: Early morning view of Pad B, KSC with ASTP Apollo/Saturn space vehicle on pad, NASA / JSC, 1975. Public domain.

elements.title: Music from the recent past
elements.text: Ten light-years out the radio picks up the melodies of a few years ago. His mission and his return have both lost their meaning.

metadata.source_quote: His mission had lost all meaning, and so had any return to Earth.

image.alt: Earth as a pale dot beneath the edge of Saturn's rings, photographed by Cassini
image.credit: Cassini’s Pale Blue Dot, NASA / GSFC, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: The radio off
elements.text: He wants to scream and smash everything; a bulletin about the terrorist threat comes on and he switches the radio off, thinking there must have been a time before all this.

metadata.source_quote: There had been a time, surely, when none of this existed

image.alt: The original Pale Blue Dot: Earth as a speck in a streak of light
image.credit: Solar System Portrait - Earth as Pale Blue Dot, NASA / JPL, 1996. Public domain.

elements.title: The insane thought
elements.text: He programs a series of jumps that will take him seventy light-years from Earth, as far as the fuel allows, ignoring the computer's warnings that he cannot come back.

metadata.source_quote: Ignoring the computer's warnings that return would be impossible, Denis worked for two hours like a man possessed.

image.alt: Diagram of Voyager 1 looking back on the planets' orbits from far outside them
image.credit: Voyager 1 Perspective for Family Portrait, NASA / JPL, 2020. Public domain.

elements.title: Supper on the floor
elements.text: He wakes to the same silence, fetches food from the galley, settles in a corner on the soft floor and turns the radio on.

metadata.source_quote: settled comfortably on the soft floor in a corner, and turned on the radio.

image.alt: A tiny Earth rising over the grey horizon of the Moon
image.credit: Lunar Satellite Snaps Image of Earth, NASA / GSFC, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: The hymn to Man
elements.text: The voices of the long dead sing that they will live forever and rule the Universe. He travels with them through cities that drift past like ghosts.

metadata.source_quote: The voices of those long dead sang to him that they would live forever.

image.alt: A technician's gloved hands placing a golden phonograph record into its case
image.credit: Voyager: Preparing the Golden Record, NASA / JPL, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: The Universe listens
elements.text: The narrator steps back: humanity lasted an instant, and its cry of amazement is now an echo crossing space. Denis and the Universe listen to it together.

image.alt: Thousands of distant galaxies scattered across the black of the Hubble Deep Field
image.credit: Hubble Deep Field Image Unveils Myriad Galaxies Back to the Beginning of Time, NASA / STScI (Hubble), 1996. Public domain.

elements.title: Denis
elements.text: A starship pilot, at first a clock-watching employee worried about fines, who flees a war, loses his reason to return and chooses to become humanity's last listener.

metadata.source_quote: Denis had the rest of his life and all the silence of creation to listen to that echo.

image.alt: A tiny Earth rising over the grey horizon of the Moon
image.credit: Lunar Satellite Snaps Image of Earth, NASA / GSFC, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: Mission Control
elements.text: The ground station that should have cleared the jump and never answers. Its silence is the first sign that the world below is ending.

image.alt: A giant dish antenna of NASA's Deep Space Network under a blue sky
image.credit: Tracks of a Giant, NASA / JPL, 2010. Public domain.

elements.title: The voices of the dead
elements.text: Singers, newsreaders and scientists of earlier decades, heard seventy light-years away, all sure that they and their works will last forever.

metadata.source_quote: They spoke of how they would rule the Universe, of how their power had no limits.

image.alt: A technician's gloved hands placing a golden phonograph record into its case
image.credit: Voyager: Preparing the Golden Record, NASA / JPL, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: The Universe
elements.text: The story's last character: it listens to the human echo alongside Denis, and is amazed.

image.alt: Thousands of distant galaxies scattered across the black of the Hubble Deep Field
image.credit: Hubble Deep Field Image Unveils Myriad Galaxies Back to the Beginning of Time, NASA / STScI (Hubble), 1996. Public domain.

elements.title: The acceleration couch
elements.text: The cocoon where the pilot waits out a jump: cramped, painful after an hour, and the place he climbs into fast so as not to change his mind.

metadata.source_quote: An acceleration couch is not the best place to rest.

image.alt: A rocket waiting on its launch pad at dawn, under a violet sky
image.credit: Early morning view of Pad B, KSC with ASTP Apollo/Saturn space vehicle on pad, NASA / JSC, 1975. Public domain.

elements.title: Ten light-years from Earth
elements.text: The planned destination. The position matches the flight plan, nobody is there, and the radio brings the music of ten years ago.

metadata.source_quote: The ship emerged ten light-years from Earth.

image.alt: Earth as a pale dot beneath the edge of Saturn's rings, photographed by Cassini
image.credit: Cassini’s Pale Blue Dot, NASA / GSFC, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: Seventy light-years from Earth
elements.text: The limit of the fuel. Silence, emptiness, a galley, a soft floor and a radio that now receives a world seventy years younger.

image.alt: A tiny Earth rising over the grey horizon of the Moon
image.credit: Lunar Satellite Snaps Image of Earth, NASA / GSFC, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: Jumps outrun light
elements.text: A starship jumps faster than light, so a pilot who jumps far enough overtakes Earth's old radio signals and can hear the past arrive.

image.alt: Diagram of Voyager 1 looking back on the planets' orbits from far outside them
image.credit: Voyager 1 Perspective for Family Portrait, NASA / JPL, 2020. Public domain.

elements.title: Jump windows and penalties
elements.text: Jumps are scheduled in allotted windows, with the hemispheres primed and energy burning; a pilot who misses one is fined.

metadata.source_quote: the hemispheres primed, energy burning, expensive equipment wearing out

image.alt: A rocket waiting on its launch pad at dawn, under a violet sky
image.credit: Early morning view of Pad B, KSC with ASTP Apollo/Saturn space vehicle on pad, NASA / JSC, 1975. Public domain.

elements.title: The war
elements.text: West against East, the Northern Alliance against the Islamists: a war whose outcome the pilot never learns.

image.alt: The original Pale Blue Dot: Earth as a speck in a streak of light
image.credit: Solar System Portrait - Earth as Pale Blue Dot, NASA / JPL, 1996. Public domain.

elements.title: The echo outlasts the voice
elements.text: Humanity's confidence in its own permanence survives only as a signal crossing empty space, heard after the speakers are dead.

metadata.source_quote: that cry scattered as an echo across space.

image.alt: A thin crescent of Earth alone in black space
image.credit: Artemis Era Earthrise, NASA / JSC, 2026. Public domain.

elements.title: Hymn against silence
elements.text: The broadcasts boast of ruling the Universe; the listener knows how it ended. The story lets the boast stand as a cry of amazement instead of mocking it.

metadata.source_quote: And through all of it rang a hymn to Man, eternal and invincible.

image.alt: A technician's gloved hands placing a golden phonograph record into its case
image.credit: Voyager: Preparing the Golden Record, NASA / JPL, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: Escape becomes listening
elements.text: Denis flees so as not to be a prisoner and ends as a witness. The trip that looks like desertion is the only act of attention left to give.

image.alt: A tiny Earth rising over the grey horizon of the Moon
image.credit: Lunar Satellite Snaps Image of Earth, NASA / GSFC, 2017. Public domain.

elements.title: Taught to hate
elements.text: What Denis knows of the enemy he learned from television, and the same radio that carried the propaganda carries the songs.

metadata.source_quote: Countless television programs had told him about the ways of those savages.

image.alt: The original Pale Blue Dot: Earth as a speck in a streak of light
image.credit: Solar System Portrait - Earth as Pale Blue Dot, NASA / JPL, 1996. Public domain.

elements.title: Pale Blue Dot (Voyager 1, 1990) and Carl Sagan
elements.text: The photograph of Earth as a speck from six billion kilometres, and Sagan's reflection on it. Readers may think of it when the narrator measures the human race as an instant.

elements.title: The Voyager Golden Record (1977)
elements.text: A disc of music, greetings and sounds sent out of the solar system for whoever finds it. Readers may see Denis as its intended listener, and human.

elements.title: Contact (Carl Sagan; film 1997)
elements.text: Aliens send back humanity's first strong television broadcast, decades old. Readers may think of the same idea: our transmissions travel outward as an expanding shell of the past.

elements.title: Earth's radio bubble
elements.text: The popular image of a sphere about a hundred light-years across filled with every broadcast humanity has made. Readers may recognise it as the story's map.

elements.title: Ozymandias (Shelley, 1818)
elements.text: A ruined statue whose inscription still boasts of its works. Readers may hear it in the voices that say their power has no limits.

elements.title: Space Oddity (David Bowie, 1969)
elements.text: Major Tom drifts away from Earth with ground control calling. Readers may hear it in the pilot and the silent Mission Control.

elements.title: The Fermi paradox and the Great Silence
elements.text: The question of why the sky holds no other voices. Readers may think of it in 'all the silence of creation', and of civilisations as brief shouts.
